require "thinkthen"

# the form, built in place. Each area is one report's:
# export, login, and billing
form = ThinkThen.set(
  steps: { decide: "Does the report give steps to reproduce?" },
  area: { choose: "Which part of the app is this?",
          options: ["export", "login", "billing"] },
  impact: { score: "How much does this block the user?",
            levels: ["None.", "Slows them.", "Blocks work."] })
reports = ["CSV export fails. Steps: click Export.",
  "The login page spins and nobody can sign in.",
  "The Pay button on the billing page is too blue."]
ThinkThen.annotate(form, reports).each { |one| p one }
